create_OGN_visualization: create an ObjectGoalNavigationVisualization instance to visualize a single object goal navigation task with a goal name and output path
snapshot_trajectory_step: call snapshot to save the current RGB, depth, semantic frames, semantic map, and collision logs as a trajectory step
record_aggregate_metrics: record aggregate metrics including path length, number of steps, collisions, and all poses to an aggregate JSON log file
update_semantic_frame: update and visualize the first-person semantic segmentation frame in the left panel of the visualization image
update_semantic_map: update and visualize the top-down semantic map with obstacle, explored, visited, and goal masks in the right panel
